subject: Atlas pilot — quick sign-off on quote & 60s recording?
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jules Pritchard <jules.pritchard@atlasretail.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas pilot — quick sign-off on quote & 60s recording?

Hi Jules / Nina —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. Quick recap of the measurable impact we observed running the recommendation rerank model in Redwood Dedicated:

- Median latency dropped from ~210ms to 95ms (53% improvement) for 2k daily active sessions on the test shard.
- Per-request inference cost reduced by ~42% after batching + KV prefix cache.
- Successful downstream CTR lift: +1.8 ppts for product detail page experiments (A/B, 95% CI).
- No customer-facing errors during the test window; overall success rate 99.98%.

I've attached a one-pager summary and a dashboard snapshot. We'd love to include a short customer quote and (if you're open) a 60-second recorded snippet we can use in a case blurb and product one-pager. Specific asks:

1) A one-line public quote we can attribute to Atlas Retail (example: “Redwood cut our inference cost and improved latency without extra ops work”).
2) Permission to do a very short recorded clip (60s) with Jules or Nina — we can use a phone call and capture audio only, or we can take a written blurb instead.

If it's easier, I'm happy to propose a 2–3 sentence draft you can edit. Do you have 15 minutes this week for a quick recording or to sign off on the one-pager?

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Karthik
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachment: atlas_poc_onepager_v3.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: dashboard_snapshot_july14.png (PNG)

From: Jules Pritchard <jules.pritchard@atlasretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@atlasretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas pilot — quick sign-off on quote & 60s recording?

Karthik —

Really pleased with the results; the latency gains and cost drop match what we saw on our side. Appreciate the clear one-pager.

We're happy to provide a short public quote and to do a 60s recording. A couple of small asks before we commit:
- Could you send a 2–3 sentence draft quote for us to edit?
- We need to confirm legal is happy with the final attribution (title + company only). I can get that turned around within 24 hours.

I'm around Fri morning PT for a quick recording. If that works, let's lock 09:30–09:45 PT.

Best,
Jules
Director, Engineering
Atlas Retail
